abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

reviews.reason: The existing probe operation directly supports the requested smallest executable investigation: observing a nearby subject or physically testing a small owned sample, with effects restricted to measured facts. Its observe, press, wet and heat modes cover feasible preliminary physical assessment without implying a comprehensive food-safety assay. The related capability search and exact probe and consult contracts have been reviewed. Reuse probe rather than develop a duplicate assessment interface. Neither the plant's maturity nor these limited tests establishes hazelnut edibility, toxicity, nutrition or required preparation.
reviews.experienceReview: Functional findings and experience are separate. This review, the request, reading a contract, registration and learning yield no experience benefit. A completed, personally applicable observation may qualify only if it verifiably adds information, including a genuinely informative failure; repeating an unchanged query or unsupported conclusion does not. Familiar legitimate hands-on practice may sustain modest benefit only through actual participation, not merely invocation. Use only an already implemented bounded experience rule with functional deduplication, an explicit cap, decay and cooldown; if none applies, grant no new pleasure or satisfaction effect in this reuse decision. No food nutrition, health gain or comfort increase is supplied by probing. Physical comfort remains capped at 10, nutrition is not reduced by mood, and protected reward accounts, budgets, goals and permissions are unchanged.
reviews.visualReview: Use observable execution events and reusable metadata identifying operation, actual target, mode, intensity, progress/status and recorded outcome. Show inspection or a physical manipulation only when it actually occurs; show wetting or heating only when its physical prerequisites are present and used. Retain sample identity, method and uncertainty with any displayed finding. An interrupted, blocked, failed or inconclusive action must be displayed as such, never with a success indicator or a safe-to-eat badge. Display no toxin, nutrition or preparation annotation unless a supporting measurement actually established it. Presentation alone supplies neither a functional effect nor experience credit.
reviews.specification:
Reuse open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, without changing its contract. Arguments are target (visible reference, maximum 360 characters), mode (observe, press, wet or heat), and intensity (number from 0 to 1). Resolve the actual visible target and validate physical access before action; do not infer or expose concealed resource properties. start-1-nuts is the observed plant, not an owned food sample. Kai currently owns only item-4-kai-35, four berries; do not create a hazelnut sample or consume those berries implicitly. To test hazelnut material, first obtain an actual owned sample through an independently executed applicable acquisition operation. The existing gather operation, base:gather:1 / forest.gather / foundation-forest@1, requires source interaction range, finite accessible stock, one round and 2 energy per unit; its quantity is an integer of at least one. Acquisition must actually transfer source stock into an identified owned stack before probe can consume a sample from it. No acquisition or travel is performed by this review.
A probe observation costs one round and 0.2 energy; a physical trial costs one round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit. Before a trial, identify the owned input stack and exact available quantity, the selected mode, and every required physical means. Bare-hand observation or pressing is the minimal option where physically applicable. Wetting requires actual accessible liquid and any necessary containment; heating requires an actual usable heat source and safe means of handling. None is supplied by this decision. If the existing handler cannot establish or account for a mode's necessary physical inputs, leave that trial unavailable rather than produce a simulated result; a genuinely missing mechanism belongs in the current-conversation development handoff. Do not invent a reagent, heat supply or diagnostic sensitivity.
Use only executable existing modes and report only their directly supported observations: for example, visible condition or an actually observed response to the performed manipulation. Do not promise any particular response. No tasting, feeding another participant, or consuming an unfamiliar sample is part of this operation. A negative limited observation means only that the tested condition was not observed under the recorded method; it is not evidence of general safety. Quantitative nutrition, toxin identity or concentration, and validated preparation requirements remain unknown unless separately supported by an applicable real measurement and its established interpretation. Reading Kai's berry record through consult does not transfer its findings to hazelnuts.
Each execution lasts one round, with interruption policy cancel: no resumable partial assay or success on an unfinished trial. Repetition is a new execution with new costs, not free progress. Record completed work, actual costs, input identity and amount, method, intensity, conditions, result and limitations. Deduct material exactly once; record consumed or altered sample as spent material/residue rather than returning it as pristine edible stock. Reusable tools remain real tools and are not duplicated. On cancellation, interruption or actor death, stop the action, preserve only completed observations, charge only actually incurred costs and leave surviving unconsumed material subject to normal inventory rules; do not refund spent energy or consumed material. Any reservation must be released once, without creating stock. No autonomous ongoing investigation, maintenance obligation or continuing benefit is created. Actual heating or other independently existing processes retain their own rules. Development/review waiting advances no world time. Execute these constraints in code rather than by repeated model approval; record reuse of the referenced handlers, not reinvention. Public availability does not grant Kai mastery, resources or permission.

reviews.visualReview: Emit observable work-start, pause, resume, cancellation, failed-validation and completed-water-transfer events with actor, target, soil-zone identity, measured dose and actual outcome. Reuse general pouring/work visuals with parameterized carrier, target, duration and progress metadata. Show water and soil-state changes only when physically committed; retain the plant's existing stage and stock visuals unless its real state changes. reviews.specification:
Current-conversation development handoff: implement general operation water_plant(target, waterItem, carrier, quantityLitres), available to any applicable actor after individual study. Target must be a reachable living rooted plant with an accessible soil/root zone; water must be real, accessible, usable freshwater controlled by the actor, and quantity must be positive and no greater than available water and carrier capacity. Require a physically suitable held carrier; a directly usable water-bearing container may satisfy both arguments. Neither water nor containers are supplied by review. No such supplies are established by this packet. Bind acquisition and carrying to existing implementation functions if available; otherwise include the minimal usable-water collection/transport dependency in this same handoff, with actual source depletion and finite carrier capacity, not a free water source or a separate activity roadmap. Do not expose undiscovered sources.
Study takes 3 simulation rounds, with ordinary metabolism and no material consumption. Execution requires two work rounds per started litre, with at most one litre per execution and 2 energy total per litre, charged proportionally to actual work. Movement and acquisition are separate actions with their existing costs. Hold the selected water against double use while work is pending; apply the measured dose only on completed execution after revalidating reach, carrier, target and water. Output is the transferred water in the target soil, with any physically rejected portion recorded as runoff or drainage; debit precisely that amount from the carrier. Never create berries, nutrients, soil fertility, plant capacity or new plants from watering.
Implementation must bind to the existing soil-moisture and growth update code, using its units, infiltration, capacity, drainage and waterlogging behavior. If the current soil model has no conserved water input, implement that minimal missing connection in this handoff: define and publish root-zone storage capacity in litres, convert retained litres to normalized moisture using that capacity, and account for overflow, drainage and subsequent evaporation. A finite documented capacity is required before execution; do not select a hidden arbitrary moisture boost. Changes to the shared soil zone affect all plants actually rooted there and must not be duplicated per target. No automatic boost to growth merely because this ability was used. Existing plant growth code remains responsible for any later growth, within its stock capacity and environmental/resource limits; missing growth requirements must be resolved in the handoff rather than inferred from stock differences. No fixed successful growth delay is established: watering takes the stated work time, while biological outcomes require subsequent actual simulation time and observations.
Use probe for a baseline and later observations; its existing costs and handler are reused, not reimplemented. At reported moisture 0.65 with no observed drought, the safe initial practice is observation and restraint, not compulsory dosing. Water only where measured conditions and the implemented plant tolerances justify it; otherwise a no-op or refusal reports why and produces no success event. Maintenance is conditional reinspection and individually initiated watering when needed, not an autonomous schedule. Watering can fail to improve growth or worsen waterlogging. Propagation is outside this minimal operation and is not asserted possible for this plant.
Persist actor, resolved target and soil-zone identity, carrier, reserved water, completed work, charged energy and status. Interruption pauses unfinished work; resume revalidates prerequisites. Cancellation releases surviving reserved water exactly once without refunding time or energy; no completed transfer is reversed. Actor death stops active work and releases surviving water through normal item/death handling, not by duplicating it. Environmental changes can invalidate or degrade pending inputs. Completed soil changes continue through ordinary world updates even if the actor leaves or dies. Development/review waiting advances no world time.

Reuse registry IDs probe, gather, navigate, pickup, wait and learn only for their existing functions and contracts; forest.wait is the supplied wait handler. Record the actual reused handlers/modules and new water-input bindings in implementation provenance. Do not claim their code as reinvention. Do not alter reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.

The recorded load-0.3 failure does not establish that higher force, a tool, or a supported cracking method will fail. No equivalent preparation function is established by the available registry. reviews.experienceReview: Functional preparation is distinct from experience. Requests, review, study, registration and nominal completion award nothing. A verified new observation of fracture, exposed structure, or a genuinely informative failed impact may qualify as information gain only when supported by an actual event and personally new evidence. Deduplicate by material/property/condition/evidence, including prior load-band evidence; repeated identical failures are not new discoveries. Optional experience implementation may grant at most 0.1 short pleasure for one personally applicable informative outcome, at most once per 10 rounds, decaying to zero over 10 rounds. Legitimate familiar hands-on preparation may sustain at most 0.1 modest satisfaction through completed physical work, with no more than one qualifying increment per 10 rounds and decay of 0.002 per elapsed round without maintenance. Route both through existing functional deduplication and applicable global caps, never protected reward accounts. These benefits are not guaranteed, confer no nutrition or mastery, and cannot be stacked with equivalent practice/discovery events. No physical-comfort award is inherent; any independently justified comfort remains capped at 10. Basic nutrition and hunger rules remain unchanged by mood.
reviews.visualReview: Render only committed events: work started, bounded impact performed, casing unchanged/damaged/fractured, separation performed, tool wear, paused/resumed/cancelled, and actual products created. Each event carries reusable metadata: operation and phase, actor, exact target/tool/support references, position, affected quantity, prior/resulting observable casing state, product IDs and quantities, progress, and outcome/evidence ID. Reuse generic impact, fracture and fragment/product visuals parameterized by real material and state; record reused renderer references in implementation. A closed-shell failure can show contact and actual damage, never an opened-shell or kernel-success image. An opened shell does not show edible/safe icons, nutrition, invisible toxins or imagined contents. Work planning and development waiting display no physical action or success. Visual completeness, subjective experience and functional success are evaluated separately.
reviews.specification:
General operation: Crack and separate a hard casing, parameterized by owned target item ID, quantity, owned striker item ID, support reference, and mode crack/separate/crack-and-separate. This is available for any applicable actor and physically suitable shelled material, not only this hazelnut instance. Minimal mechanism: controlled supported impacts followed by manual removal of accessible loose casing; no cutting, cooking, toxin removal or eating. Preconditions: living actor able to manipulate material, sufficient energy, target under exclusive work reservation and within 0.65 m, an actually owned suitable hard blunt striker, and a stable accessible support within reach. Validate tool hardness, integrity, geometry and support stability against actual material properties. A suitable real stone may serve as striker; neither a stone nor a support is supplied by learning. No known owned tool currently satisfies this requirement. start-1-stone is an observed source at (15,10.5), not an owned tool or an automatic usable support. Kai must independently travel, gather suitable loose material if actually available, and position it through existing actions with their own costs; the operation cannot silently perform those actions. If material/tool suitability cannot yet be represented, implement the minimal contact/fracture and component-separation mechanism in this handoff rather than treating the missing primitive as rejection.
Contract costs: study takes 3 rounds individually, with ordinary time-dependent needs and no material consumption; it grants no item or completed work. Execution accepts positive quantities in the engine's representable material quantum; maximum 1 unit per job. Quote quantity, tool condition, exact phase count and maximum energy before starting. Each started block of at most 0.1 unit takes one cracking round at 1 energy and, if accessible fragments exist, one separation round at 0.5 energy. A failed cracking block does not incur an unperformed separation phase. Each cracking block performs one bounded supported impact, not an automatic escalation loop. Thus 0.9 units requires at most 18 work rounds and 13.5 energy for one pass, excluding travel, acquisition and study. Tool wear, material damage and any byproduct losses must follow a declared deterministic contact model; expose their cost bounds before authorization. Do not invent a tool-life figure or a shell/kernel yield from the pressure trial. Insufficient energy or invalid references prevent the next phase without charging it. Failed real impacts still spend their actual round and energy and may physically damage the sample or tool. Reattempts are new paid work on the remaining state.
Implement fracture using actual casing resistance, tool contact and impact bounds, then separate only components made physically accessible. Resolve any absent internal structure or fracture metadata in the development implementation, not by reporting hidden nutrition or toxins to the actor. No fixed success probability, arbitrary kernel fraction, free stock or guaranteed intact kernel. If the attempt leaves the casing closed, retain the affected target as closed or damaged and report that outcome. If it opens but no kernel is accessible, produce only the exposed fragments and residual material actually present. Products are owned, separately addressable casing fragments, accessible kernel material, damaged mixed material, and any accounted debris, with origin and parent references. Preserve original spoilage/contamination state and elapsed aging; processing cannot refresh food. Source quantity equals all resulting recoverable quantities plus explicitly tracked debris/loss, using a finer internal mass ledger if needed rather than rounding up products. Never copy the source into products while leaving its quantity intact. Wear debris likewise debits the tool. Opening establishes neither edibility nor nutrition, safety or toxin removal. Keep unverified kernel unavailable to any edible-resource shortcut until independently justified by the existing food rules; no automatic eating.
Reference handling: resolve and pin exact item identities at start, reserve only the selected material, and revalidate ownership, reach, tool condition and actor state before each phase. Kai's candidate source is item-16-kai-161, quantity 0.9, origin start-1-nuts; item-4-kai-35 is unrelated berry stock and is not an implicit input. Evidence event-17-kai-172 supports only the recorded press outcome. Record actual parent IDs, tool/support IDs, quantities, work phase, completed block count and physical state after every committed phase. A pause or interruption preserves completed irreversible fractures and recoverable products, releases no duplicate stock, and permits resume only with current valid prerequisites. Cancellation releases surviving reserved material once; spent time, energy, wear, damage and scattered material are not refunded. Death cancels active work and leaves surviving items/products at the physical worksite under ordinary death/ownership rules, without resurrection or duplication. Global pause and development waiting perform no phases and consume no world time. No autonomous ongoing process; paused work and products remain subject to ordinary decay. Maintenance consists only of checking and replacing physically worn tools through independently available actions; no automatic repair.
Dependencies and reuse: retain existing ownership, reservation, reach, energy, work-progress, inventory, decay and event infrastructure where present, and record the actual reused module IDs/revisions in the implementation change record. Existing contracts referenced, not reinvented: open.probe at foundation-open@1 for the already measured evidence only; forest.pickup at foundation-forest@1 for separately requested collection; base:gather:1 for separately requested source extraction. Do not claim unseen fracture code already exists or replace those actions with free transfers. The new handler must execute validation, accounting and outcome rules in code, with tests for failure, partial output, interruption, insufficient energy, death and replay/idempotency; no repeated model adjudication at runtime. Other actors, if involved later, must communicate and execute their own actions independently.

reviews.specification:
General operation: shape-and-use-wooden-digging-tool, parameterized by owned target, quantity, abrasive/support references, soil target, workId and mode; modes inspect, shape, trial/use, maintain, pause, resume and cancel share one implementation. Minimal manufacture method is controlled abrasion of an existing suitable wooden end; no cutting edge, fire, water or binding is assumed. Dependencies: existing ownership/reservation, reach, item provenance, energy/time and event systems; reuse probe's observation/material-response implementation where applicable and record exact reused IDs, versions and functions in the handoff. Add missing material-removal, tool-condition and localized soil-displacement code in that same handoff. No execution or world time passes during review/development.
Prerequisites and references: name the actual owned unreserved stock item, quantity in supported increments, and an individually identifiable blank selected from it. For this applicant the candidate source is item-9-moss-89, currently 1.6 branch units. The root item item-2-moss-11 is not an ingredient. Require actual reachable firm support and an owned or otherwise legitimately usable, reachable abrasive surface whose physical properties permit wood removal; none is granted or presumed available. Ground may provide support only if actually stable. A suitably rough stone must be found/acquired if no usable abrasive surface exists. Inspection must establish accessible dimensions, structural condition and an achievable rounded or tapered working end; aggregate stock quantity alone does not prove there is a coherent blank. Missing dimensions/material properties must be represented and checked through ordinary local inspection, without exposing remote stock or unrelated hidden attributes. Quote unavailable prerequisites rather than inventing them. No water is required.
Costs and progress: study takes 4 rounds individually, without granting material, completed work or mastery. A committed local inspection takes 1 round and 0.5 energy and returns only observable facts. Select a valid blank quantity q, at least the material system's minimum increment, with q no greater than owned unreserved stock. Before commitment, quote q, predicted removal bound, number of abrasion strokes/rounds, energy and support/abrasive wear from implemented material and geometry rules. Each shaping work round performs one bounded abrasion stroke for 1 energy; at most four strokes per submitted work segment, with explicit continuation for more. A smaller end can be made only as fast as the implemented removal rate permits. A zero-removal contact still costs its actual round and effort and reports failure to abrade. Abrasive/support damage is calculated per actual contact; unsupported or physically incapable material is not silently effective. A trial/use stroke takes 1 round and 1 energy; a maintenance stroke takes 1 round and 1 energy and uses the same abrasion/removal rules. No charges occur for a rejected precondition or a read-only work/condition quote. Do not silently commit extra segments or gather prerequisites.
Manufacture and conservation: reserve the identified blank and any exclusively required implements while work is active. Track removed material, taper/end dimensions, remaining cross-section, cracks and actual condition after every stroke. Transfer removed wood into attributable debris at the worksite, preserving source identity and total represented mass; abrasive wear likewise becomes accounted debris. Resource units must use the existing material-to-mass convention rather than treating one branch unit as an invented kilogram. The blank plus wood debris must equal the input wood mass, with no new food or other resource produced. Release a shaped item only when the measured geometry meets the declared end-shape criterion and sufficient shaft remains; retain an unfinished or damaged blank otherwise. An item may be visibly shaped without being verified useful. Quantity reserved is not quantity destroyed.
Use and useful effects: require a particular reachable, physically represented soil patch, a held tool, a chosen bounded stroke/load and sufficient condition. Resolve each stroke against the actual end geometry, tool response, soil resistance, displacement and obstruction rules in code. If those rules do not exist, implement the minimal bounded loose-surface-soil interaction rather than simulating success through a label. Start trials at no more than the previously observed 0.25 load where that calibration is applicable; this is not a guarantee for a shaped or different piece. Do not extrapolate the failed 0.5 load as a safe operating limit. A stroke can displace only the volume supported by its actual contact and available work, capped at 0.001 cubic metres per stroke for this initial implementation. Move that same soil volume into a local loose-soil/deposit representation; do not delete soil, conjure excavation products, expose hidden resource contents or automatically gather anything. Report measured displaced volume, penetration if represented, tool deformation/damage and energy paid, including zero displacement. Establish tool usefulness only after an actual nonzero tool-mediated soil displacement event. A failure may damage or break the tool, with fragments conserved; it cannot grant a successful-tool state. No automatic gathering multiplier, excavation of hard ground, improved nutrition or unrelated effectiveness is included.
Persistence, maintenance and stopping: work records retain exact source, tool, abrasive, support and soil IDs, reserved quantities, phase, strokes completed, cumulative time/energy, debris and condition. Recheck ownership/access, reach, physical prerequisites and sufficient energy before each paid stroke. Missing prerequisites, movement, exhaustion or interruption pause work with completed changes intact and no charge for an unexecuted stroke. Pause/resume/cancel are controls with no material/energy charge; they cause no physical progress. Resume requires actual return and revalidation of the recorded inputs, with stale geometry/condition recomputed if another legitimate action changed them. Cancellation releases all remaining inputs in their present condition; already spent time, energy and material wear are never refunded. Death ends the actor's work and releases tangible remaining inputs, unfinished tools and debris at the worksite under ordinary death/ownership rules, without duplication or automatic delivery. Study retains only completed study progress under the existing learning rules and requires a living actor to continue. Tools retain wear and environmental deterioration under explicit item rules; maintenance removes real additional material and cannot restore lost mass or heal structural cracks for free. Stop use at the implemented breakage/unsafe-condition threshold. No autonomous digging, maintenance or resource production occurs after the action or while paused. Other participants must communicate and act through their own interfaces; none is enrolled or made to consent by this operation.

Watering commons-berry-0-0 at its measured moisture 0.65 is not indicated by the berry requirement 0.6. Develop a general seed-propagation operation, initially supporting extraction and sowing trials where the represented plant biology permits them. Seed presence, viability, germination requirements and growth timing must be resolved in the current development handoff, not inferred from the name 'berry' or replaced by an instant plant grant. Implemented at the preserved round boundary.
reviews.experienceReview: No benefit for the request, development, naming, study completion or mastery. A completed extraction, measured site investigation, informative failed trial or observed establishment may count only when it gives lin personally new, evidence-backed information. Familiar successful care may support modest satisfaction without requiring novelty. For any such implemented credit, use the existing experience mechanism with functional deduplication by lineage/site, property and evidence event; at most one short-pleasure increment of 0.01 and one maintained-satisfaction increment of 0.01 per qualifying event, combined propagation contribution capped at 0.1, cooldown 10 rounds per equivalent result, satisfaction decay 0.002 per ordinary round. Repeated status queries and unobserved background growth earn nothing. No physical-comfort award is proposed; physical comfort remains capped at 10. Do not change basic nutrition, protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.
reviews.visualReview: Emit observable, timestamped extraction, sowing, inspection, establishment, failure and death events only when those actions or transitions occur. Reusable visual metadata must include work ID, source lineage, site position, phase, completed/required labor, visible material state, plant stage and evidence ID. Distinguish unverified seed, sown patch, emerged seedling and established plant. Failed extraction shows no seed product; sowing is not displayed as a rooted plant, and interrupted work never displays completion. Growth may exist without immediate personal knowledge; update personal records only through an actual observation.
reviews.specification:
General operation: propagate from seed, parameterized by owned source item, quantity, accessible planting site and work ID, with extract, sow, inspect, pause, resume and cancel modes. Initial scope is hand extraction and shallow sowing of seeds that can actually be separated by hand; this does not presume tools, vessels, suitable cuttings or seeds in inventory. Exact immediate source candidate: item-6-lin-57, six berries owned by lin, origin commons-berry-0-0. Recheck its surviving quantity, decay and ownership at execution; do not consume all six by default. commons-berry-0-0 is a parent reference, not a supply of free cuttings or permission to damage it. The later tick-20 observation still reports stock 6 and moisture 0.65; other plants' fruit stocks do not establish propagation feasibility.
Development handoff must inspect the existing biological representation and related handlers before coding. Reuse and record applicable inventory, observation, soil, growth, decay and work code by exact handler/revision where available; recorded related contracts include rooted-plant-watering, forest.gather at foundation-forest@1, and open.probe at foundation-open@1. Do not claim their implementation as new invention. Missing seed separation, seed identity, sowing or establishment mechanisms belong in this same handoff. Add only the minimum coherent seed lifecycle needed; do not add an unrelated toolmaking or agriculture roadmap. If berry seed anatomy or germination cannot yet be supported by justified biological parameters, implement the actual extraction/site-inspection precursor and report the precise remaining dependency rather than generating a rooted plant.
Proposed work costs: learning 4 active study rounds; each study round uses 0.2 energy, with ordinary hunger/time continuing. Interrupted work cannot claim a finding. Preserve any real partial physical change and spent inputs if they already occurred; release unconsumed reservations once, with no refund of spent effort, time or consumed sample. reviews.reason: The existing general observation operation already provides the smallest feasible safe assessment: examine the actual sample without ingesting or physically exposing its contents, record only observable findings, and leave nutrition and toxicity unresolved. Its arguments cover unfamiliar food as well as other subjects. Neither appearance nor an observed mature plant establishes food safety. The related consult, gather, and crack-and-separate-casing functions do not establish toxicity either; no new assay or duplicate inspection capability is justified for this limited assessment.
reviews.experienceReview: No reward follows from this review, request, choosing a method, reading a contract or possessing the ability. A completed observation may qualify only for genuinely verified, personally applicable information gain, including an informative limitation actually established by the attempt. A mere statement that toxicity is unknown is not a new discovery. Apply existing experience rules in code with functional deduplication, bounded benefit, cooldown and decay; repeated identical inspections cannot farm novelty. This action grants no nutrition, physical comfort or automatic satisfaction and cannot change protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions.
reviews.visualReview: Use the existing probe execution and observable event, not a new assay animation. Reusable presentation metadata should identify action=observe, target reference, method=external-visual, progress and outcome, with findings linked to their evidence event. Display an observation pose or inspection indicator only while actual execution occurs, then show only supported external findings and the unresolved-safety limitation. An unavailable target, interrupted action or inadequate visibility must display failure or incompletion, never a successful assessment badge. Do not show hidden toxins, nutrition values, interior imagery, edibility confirmation or a safety glow.
reviews.specification: Reuse probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1, handler open.probe, revision foundation-open@1, without claiming a new implementation. Proposed execution arguments are target=item-23-wren-242, mode=observe, intensity=0. This item is the already gathered, owned hazelnut sample, quantity 1, origin start-1-nuts; do not gather another sample automatically. At execution, resolve the exact item reference and require that the sample is currently visible and within observation reach. Ownership alone does not establish reach; navigation, if necessary, is separate and costs actual travel. Perform an external visual inspection without tasting, licking, deliberate inhalation, opening, heating, wetting or pressing. Require adequate existing visibility; supply no light, tools, reagents or protective equipment. One completed observation costs one simulation round and 0.2 energy, consumes no material, and leaves the sample quantity, casing, food value and toxicity unchanged apart from ordinary elapsed-world processes. Report only properties actually accessible to the observation method, such as externally visible casing condition if represented and visible. Do not invent a measured feature merely to make the assessment informative. Attach the target instance, method, conditions, execution tick and actual observation event reference to each finding. Explicitly report that this method does not establish internal condition, species identity, nutrition, toxin concentration, allergens or fitness to eat; hidden resource values cannot be disclosed. If no useful distinction is observable, report that limitation rather than safety. Retain wren's root finding separately; it does not transfer to hazelnuts. No eating or follow-up action is automatic. Optional later casing processing must use crack-and-separate-casing with its own individual study, owned striker, support, material reservation and costs; the present inventory does not demonstrate an owned striker, and opening a casing would still not establish safety. This is a single-round action, not an ongoing project: interruption cancels the unfinished interaction, with no completed finding or success event; a retry is a new probe rather than resumed progress. Preserve any actually incurred costs, refund no spent effort, and do not consume sample material for observation. Death cancels unfinished execution and grants no findings or mastery. No maintenance, reservation, passive investigation or continuing process is created. Development or review waiting advances no simulation time. Execute the established probe contract in code, not through repeated model adjudication.
